comments.body:
Any update on this? I encounter the same error "AttributeError: module 'torch.fx._symbolic_trace' has no attribute 'List'".

Have been trying earlier versions but without luck. For as well, it appears in the context of the setup for heterogeneous graphs (to_hetero()) when loosely following https://medium.com/@pytorch_geometric/link-prediction-on-heterogeneous-graphs-with-pyg-6d5c29677c70

For some reason, it also doesn't work when installing PyG 2.7.0 from git, as is the case when running the [original Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1r_FWLSFf9iL0OWeHeD31d_Opt031P1Nq?usp=sharing&pli=1#scrollTo=ebsFf-Pr_4LF).

---

Noticed too late that I should downgrade torch to ~2.4. Works fine. Should also work up to torch 2.6 when running the Colab instead of the local Notebook.
